entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-06-09
entry.content:
Issues

  • Enable VirtualProjectXmlProviderTests in CI #78879
    .NET 10
  • Determine if a source file contains top-level statements without doing a full additional parse. #78878
    .NET 10
  • "Introduce local" in top-level program creates the local at the global scope, breaking references #78875
    Backlog
  • High memory consumption for mid-sized solution #78868

Closed

    17.13
  • Add CommandLineResource API #78678
